metadata.title: SYNTHETIC DEMO — Aurora Station
metadata.description: Original fictional benchmark sample. Not part of Detroit: Become Human.

arrival.heading: A distress signal
arrival.description: You dock at an abandoned research station. The emergency beacon reports two missing crew members. A warning light pulses over the airlock.

arrival_decision.heading: Before entering
arrival_decision.description: You have time for one preliminary action before the hatch seals.

options.label: Scan the station for life signs

scan_result.heading: The scanner responds
scan_result.description: You discover one faint life sign near the reactor and another signal by the medical bay.

rush_result.heading: Inside the airlock
rush_result.description: You enter without scanning. You have less information, but arrive sooner.

entry_decision.heading: The silent corridor
entry_decision.description: The corridor divides into a medical wing and an engineering wing.

med_room.heading: Medical wing
med_room.description: You find a damaged medkit and evidence of a hurried evacuation.

eng_room.heading: Engineering wing
eng_room.description: You find a console displaying an imminent power failure.

second_chapter.heading: The emergency broadcast
second_chapter.description: An automated message asks for help. The station can be stabilized, but doing so may delay the search.

power_decision.heading: Allocate your time
power_decision.description: Choose whether to secure infrastructure or prioritize locating the crew.

power_restored.heading: Lights return
power_restored.description: Emergency power comes online throughout the station.

power_ignored.heading: Time is running out
power_ignored.description: The halls grow darker as you continue the search.

rescue_decision.heading: A voice through the wall
rescue_decision.description: A trapped technician calls for help. The secure research archive is nearby.

technician_rescued.heading: A life saved
technician_rescued.description: You free the technician, who thanks you and warns of reactor instability.

archive_secured.heading: The archive
archive_secured.description: You secure the research records but leave the technician trapped for now.

final_chapter.heading: At the reactor
final_chapter.description: A reactor fault threatens the remaining crew. A single control lever can isolate the hazard, but the procedure is uncertain.

reactor_decision.heading: Reactor protocol
reactor_decision.description: Choose a response to the unstable reactor.

stabilized.heading: Manual override
stabilized.description: The reactor stops accelerating, but the last bulkhead is still locked.

evacuation.heading: Evacuation signal
evacuation.description: You order the survivors to evacuate and head for the extraction hatch.

last_decision.heading: The final hatch
last_decision.description: The escape shuttle has arrived. There is one opportunity to act before departure.

options.label: Wait for the last crew member

branches.condition_text: Reactor stabilized and waited for crew

best_ending.description: Synthetic demo ending: reactor stabilized and evacuation delayed for the missing crew.

other_ending.description: Synthetic demo ending: the rescue concludes with unresolved consequences.
